Office of Administration

File No.: IIT-Admin-PNT-2023-00010 Date:-February 13, 2025

NO OBJECTION CERTIFICATE

1. This is to certify that Mr. Rajan Thomas (Employee ID: I1251044) has been serving at the Indian Institute of Technology Indore since July 9, 2012 (FN). Presently, he holds the position of Assistant Registrar since July 11, 2018. His current basic pay is ₹67,000/- as per Pay Level 10, Cell No. 7 of the 7th CPC.

2. The Institute hereby issues a No Objection Certificate for Mr. Rajan Thomas to apply for the post of Deputy Registrar in Pay Level 12 (₹78,800/- to ₹2,09,200/-) as per the 7th CPC as advertised in the NIT Karnataka, Surathkal Advertisement No. 5213-NITK-NTR/Admin.-Estt./2025/B1 dated January 7, 2025.

3. It is certified from the CVO of the Institute that there are no vigilance cases contemplated/pending against him.

4. Upon being selected for the said position, Mr. Rajan Thomas will be relieved from his services at IIT Indore as per the approval of the Institute Authority for the same following the Institute norms.

To
Mr. Rajan Thomas
Assistant Registrar
IIT Indore
